distance_summary: SCNS is NOT yet usable at the north star on ANY of the five capabilities. safe_outward is closest (measured_with_controls: deny-all + fail-closed, wired-live, pos/neg controlled tests) but lacks an archived live e2e row. trustworthy_recall and self_learning are built but not wired-live/measured (the faithful MAGMA path is default-OFF with only a measured NULL; the per-attempt accept-vs-waste loop has 0 live callers). self_direction is built as deterministic, SCNS-scoped heuristics with no machine-aware scheduler and no new-app self-direction (BLOCKED). voice_cloning is only specified -- no persona/voice subsystem, no texts ingestion (BLOCKED). The honest distance: the safety substrate is strong, memory recall is one scoped fix (US2/MAGMA) from being measurable, self-learning needs live loop-closure, and the two headline autonomy moonshots (self-direction, voice-cloning) are largely unbuilt downstream work.
